text_block_list.text:
That day, Victoire Pisa was learning bead 
weaving from Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
—That's it, looking good. That's the basic 
braid, so after this, you just keep 
repeating and connecting them~.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"And finally, we weave it back through... 
How does that look, Acute-san?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! That's simply marvelous~ Pisa-chan 
really knows how to get the hang of 
things.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, it's all thanks to how well and 
thoroughly you taught me, Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no need to be modest. Maybe it 
really is thanks to you making accessories 
all the time.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Now that you mention it, that's 
true.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Since I am accustomed to delicate work 
like connecting small parts, bead weaving 
might actually feel surprisingly natural 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Fascinating, isn't it? To think that an 
experience in one area could be applied to 
something entirely different—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it, it's not just 
beadwork. There have been plenty of other 
times when being good with detailed work 
saved the day...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Pisa-chan? Your hands stopped moving. Is 
there something you're having trouble 
with?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: N-No... I just figured out a few things.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Knowledge and experiences really do 
connect together, don't they? Just like 
these beads...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep passing this forward. 
Carefully and steadily carrying on 
everything I've learned.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... How wonderful. It'll be okay, I 
know you can do it, Pisa-chan.

Realizing that everything is connected, 
Victoire Pisa would go on to gain 
confidence through a variety of 
experiences.
